stories.title: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña impeached and arrested
stories.summary: Paraguay's Congress ousted and arrested President Santiago Peña amid a banking crisis that left millions of people unable to access their money.

stories.title: At least six killed in shooting in Kraków's Main Market Square
stories.summary: A gunman opened fire from a car in Kraków's historic main square, killing at least six people and injuring more than 15 before police shot and wounded him.

stories.title: Russia fires 36 missiles and 172 drones at Kyiv, hitting energy grid
stories.summary: Russia targeted Kyiv's energy infrastructure overnight, damaging the Northern Bridge and knocking out power, water and heat ahead of next week's US-Ukraine-Russia talks.

stories.title: Anthropic's AI is speeding up its own development, METR report finds
stories.summary: An AI safety group found Anthropic's models are improving roughly twice as fast as a year ago, with most of the acceleration driven by AI itself rather than more computing power.

stories.title: Saints' Granderson says New Orleans is 'coming in hot' after Sanders' comments
stories.summary: New Orleans DE Carl Granderson says the Saints will be ready for Browns QB Shedeur Sanders, who makes his first 2026 start Sunday in Week 9.

stories.title: Buckeyes say 'the playoffs have started early' ahead of Oregon
stories.summary: Ohio State players stress urgency after the USC loss, with eight Buckeyes listed out for Saturday's game against Oregon.

stories.title: Ohio State's Timmons cleared to play; Inniss out vs. Oregon
stories.summary: Ohio State gets starting safety Jay Timmons back for Saturday's game against Oregon but will be without receivers Brandon Inniss and Brock Boyd.

stories.title: Ohio State vs. Oregon is a College Football Playoff eliminator
stories.summary: No. 12 Ohio State needs a win over No. 23 Oregon to stay in playoff contention, with freshman QB Luke Fahey starting again for the injured Julian Sayin.

stories.title: Haas boss Komatsu says Ocon axing 'surprised everybody'
stories.summary: Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu said the team's decision to drop Esteban Ocon surprised everyone at Haas, casting fresh doubt on the Frenchman's F1 future.

stories.title: Antonelli dominates Brazil long runs as Ferrari endures a 'nightmare' Friday
stories.summary: Kimi Antonelli topped long-run pace at Interlagos while Ferrari struggled for speed, leaving Charles Leclerc describing it as 'one of the worst feelings.'

stories.title: Ralf Schumacher slams Colton Herta's F1 prospects: 'He's just burning fuel'
stories.summary: Ralf Schumacher dismissed Colton Herta's chances in F1 as the American driver's 2027 seat remains the subject of speculation.

stories.title: Racing Bulls promises 'right decision' as Lawson's F1 future stays in doubt
stories.summary: Racing Bulls says it will make the 'right decision' on Liam Lawson's future, with the driver's seat for 2027 still unresolved.

stories.title: Who is Patrick Havas, alleged attacker at Amy Acton campaign event
stories.summary: NBC4 identifies Patrick Havas, the man accused in an attack at a Dr. Amy Acton campaign event; reports tie him to a former Franklin County campaign chair for Sen. Husted.

stories.title: Columbus man reverses guilty plea in deadly road-rage shooting
stories.summary: A Columbus man who pleaded guilty to involuntary manslaughter in a deadly road-rage shooting has retained new counsel and reversed his plea.
